Scopes open on the handler thread and close on that same thread in reverse order. The invocation waits for * scope cleanup before dispatching invocation-end hooks, including during suspension or termination. There is no * cleanup deadline: a blocking close can delay invocation-end hooks and caller return indefinitely. Ordinary cleanup * preserves the winning outcome; observed VirtualMachineError/ThreadDeath from scope callbacks escapes the invocation * caller.
